acceptedAnswer.text: A2 Hosting was a web host that is now called hosting.com. World Host Group bought it in January 2025, and the new name was announced in April 2025. The plans are sold under hosting.com.

Yes. hosting.com's own blog says A2 Hosting is now hosting.com, and a2hosting.com now points to hosting.com. Plan names changed too: Startup became Starter, Drive became Plus, Turbo Boost became Pro and Turbo Max became Max.

It tests well on speed and uptime. HostingAdvice measured a 579 ms Largest Contentful Paint, and Website Planet measured 100% uptime. CNET found setup complicated and support poor, and the renewal price is high.

mainEntity.name: How much does A2 Hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the November 2026 Black Friday offer, Starter was $1.49 a month on a 12-month term, Pro $3.49 and Max $5.99. A 48-month Starter was $1.99. Managed WordPress plans start at $4.49 a month.

mainEntity.name: How much does A2 Hosting cost after renewal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starter renews at $13.99 a month, Pro at $19.99 and Max at $27.99. That is 9.4 times the 12-month Starter price. WordPress Small renews at $9.99 and Medium at $17.99.

mainEntity.name: Does A2 Hosting offer WordPress hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. WordPress runs on every plan with one-click install, and hosting.com sells managed WordPress plans from $4.49 a month. They include a CDN, WP Rocket, two firewalls and a 99.99% uptime guarantee.

mainEntity.name: Does A2 Hosting have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 30 days on shared, WordPress, email and reseller hosting. It does not cover domains, renewals, VPS plans, dedicated servers or SSL certificates. A2's older anytime guarantee is gone.

mainEntity.name: How do I cancel A2 Hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact support within 30 days of buying for a refund. After that, cancel before the renewal date, because plans renew automatically and a saved payment method may be charged three days before it.

mainEntity.name: Is there an A2 Hosting coupon code?

acceptedAnswer.text: hosting.com's Black Friday page applies the deal automatically. One affiliate newsletter listed an extra code, so check the cart. Promotional prices apply to the first term only.
Yes in tests. HostingAdvice measured 579 ms Largest Contentful Paint, and Website Planet measured pages loading in 0.8 to 2.2 seconds. Speeds were slower in Singapore and Australia.
hosting.com lists 24/7/365 support. HostingAdvice found live chat replies in seconds, and CNET rated support poor. Check which channels your plan includes.
hosting.com allows 5 sites and daily backups on its entry plan against 3 sites and weekly backups on Hostinger Premium. Hostinger renews lower, at $10.99 against $13.99.
